Hi Alex —

Thanks for taking the time this morning — quick recap from our discovery: 

- Goal: evaluate Redwood to reduce inference cost and lower tail latency for real-time features in ACME’s customer chat product.
- Current pain: unpredictable latency at peak and costly overprovisioning; need predictable per-request SLOs and lower unit costs.
- Success metrics you called out: 95th percentile latency <150ms, 40% token cost reduction vs current infra, and ability to pin model versions per environment.

Next step: demo + technical deep dive with our Solutions Engineer (Marissa) to walk through integration patterns, routing policies, and dedicated capacity options.

Proposed slots (all PT):
- Tue Mar 8 — 11:00–11:45am
- Wed Mar 9 — 9:00–9:45am
- Thu Mar 10 — 2:00–2:45pm

If none of these work, reply with 2 times that do. I’ve attached a short agenda and a pricing snapshot for context (redwood-demo-agenda.pdf, redwood-pricing-v2.pdf).

Also including Marissa on the thread so she can prepare the technical topics.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
